pedidos.pedido: P [1514]: 'Approximately half of the Big Sur coastal zone is in public ownership' (R066). P [79]: 'Approximately half of the planning area's 150,000 acres are within the Los Padres National Forest' (R067; os 150.000 acres ficam fora). P [2880]: 'Forest Service owns 75,000 acres' (R068). P [1641]: 'Land uses permitted in the Ventana Wilderness portion of the National Forest are limited to backcountry recreation' (R069). Tela ≈ HALF FEDERAL LAND · MONTEREY COUNTY PLAN (1986); U.S. FOREST SERVICE.
